title: Presentation factorization with a smooth algebra having the same reduction
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $\Lambda$ a commutative $R$-algebra, and $I\subset R$ an ideal. Suppose $\Lambda/I\Lambda$ is a filtered colimit of smooth $R/I$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-smooth-algebras]. Let $A$ be a finitely presented $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra] and $\varphi:A\to\Lambda$ an $R$-algebra homomorphism. There exist a finitely presented $R$-algebra $A'$, $R$-algebra homomorphisms $\iota:A\to A'$ and $\varphi':A'\to\Lambda$ with $\varphi'\circ\iota=\varphi$, a smooth $R$-algebra $B$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], and an isomorphism $B/IB\cong A'/IA'$ of $R$-algebras. Here $IC$ is the ideal generated by the image of $I$ in an $R$-algebra $C$. No nilpotence assumption on $I$ is required.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Tag 07CK (lemma-lift-once), proof lines 1255--1296, before formally smooth lifting

proof.text: Apply the ind standard smooth refinement theorem to Lambda/I Lambda over R/I. It turns the given filtered colimit of smooth algebras into a filtered colimit of standard smooth algebras.

Apply the standard smooth reduction factor construction to obtain a finitely presented A prime and maps iota and phi prime with phi prime composed with iota equal to phi, and with A prime/IA prime standard smooth over R/I.

Lift this standard smooth R/I-algebra to a standard smooth R-algebra B with an R/I-algebra isomorphism B/IB to A prime/IA prime. Standard smooth implies smooth. Restrict the isomorphism along R to R/I, obtaining exactly the R-algebra isomorphism required in the statement. Combine these witnesses with the factorization equality from the preceding step.

theorem exists_smooth_reduction_factorization
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (Λ : Type (max u v)) [CommRing Λ] [Algebra R Λ]
    (I : Ideal R)
    (hΛ : ObjectProperty.ind.{max u v}
      (fun C : CommAlgCat.{max u v} (R ⧸ I) ↦ Smooth (R ⧸ I) C)
      (CommAlgCat.of (R ⧸ I) (Λ ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R Λ))))
    (A : Type w) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [FinitePresentation R A]
    (φ : A →ₐ[R] Λ) :
    ∃ (A' : Type (max u v w)) (_ : CommRing A') (_ : Algebra R A'),
      FinitePresentation R A' ∧
      ∃ (ι : A →ₐ[R] A') (φ' : A' →ₐ[R] Λ), φ'.comp ι = φ ∧
      ∃ (B : Type (max u v w)) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : Algebra R B),
        Smooth R B ∧
          Nonempty ((B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R B)) ≃ₐ[R]
            (A' ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R A')))
